notes: Koyna Dam’s straight 807.72 m gravity crest, repeated reinforcing buttresses, six radial gates and ogee spillway, striped crest tower, powerhouse and walled stilling basin. The crest frame follows 669.82 m of mapped reservoir shoreline and includes 68.95 m modeled land ties at both ends to reach the documented length. Buttress sections, crest houses and unmarked power station elevations are exterior approximations. The standard sampled reservoir stage is about 17 m below full pool. Near-bank terrain includes spurious low samples. The design fixture and sampled-stage comparison record this difference. Gates are shown dry and closed. The approach bridge and roads remain native. Underground generating works are outside the model.
